name: Admin Proposal Section Dirty Guard
description: Unsaved-changes protection in the proposal section editor: editing a section shows a "Sin guardar" badge; collapsing a dirty section, navigating away, reloading or hitting the panel refresh button asks for confirmation before discarding edits. The page-level guard now runs on the shared useUnsavedGuard (same composable as admin-document-unsaved-guard) and renders a notice above the tab strip — outside every tab, since the pending work may sit in one the operator is not looking at — naming what is pending ("Secciones y tarifa por hora sin guardar") instead of only reporting that something is. It stays a two-exit dialog (salir sin guardar / seguir editando): the proposal has no atomic save, each SectionEditor saves its own block, so a "Guardar y salir" would promise something this page cannot yet deliver.
